title: XRechnung – Invalid XML Generated When Invoice Discount Percentage Exceeds 2 Decimals
summary: Fixed invalid XML generation in XRechnung when invoice discount percentage has more than 2 decimal places by reverting a previous regression.
key_points: Corrects XML output for XRechnung e-invoices with discount percentages exceeding 2 decimals
Reverts a prior regression that caused invalid XML formatting
Includes updated test coverage for the corrected behavior
